lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 내일 기말시험 준비 다 했어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, are you all ready for tomorrow's final exam?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, naeil gimalsiheom junbi da haesseoyo?
lines.learner: 아직이요. 오늘 밤에 한 과목 더 공부해요.
lines.en: Not yet. I'm studying one more subject tonight.
lines.roman: Ajigiyo. Oneul bame han gwamok deo gongbuhaeyo.

lines.learner: 자기 전에 문제를 풀고 정답을 확인해요.
lines.en: Before bed, I solve problems and check the answers.
lines.roman: Jagi jeone munjereul pulgo jeongdabeul hwaginhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. What do you do with words you don't know?
lines.en: I look them up in my e-dictionary. It's very handy.

lines.learner: 아, 시험 보기 전에 배터리를 갈아야겠어요.
lines.en: Oh, I should change the battery before the exam.
lines.roman: A, siheom bogi jeone baeteorireul garayagesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How's the intermediate course these days?
lines.learner: 어렵지만 재미있어요. 집중이 잘 안 돼서 걱정이에요.
lines.en: It's hard but fun. I worry because I can't focus well.
lines.roman: Eoryeopjiman jaemiisseoyo. Jipjungi jal an dwaeseo geokjeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: It helps to turn off your phone before studying.
lines.en: Good idea. I'll try it starting today.

lines.beaver: 이번 시험에 합격하면 뭐 할 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: What will you do if you pass this exam?
lines.beaver_roman: Ibeon siheome hapgyeokamyeon mwo hal geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 다음 과정으로 올라가요. 내년엔 입학시험도 봐요.
lines.en: I'll move up to the next course. Next year I take an entrance exam too.
lines.roman: Daeum gwajeongeuro ollagayo. Naenyeonen ipaksiheomdo bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing! Is the entrance exam hard?
lines.learner: 네, 그래서 시험 보기 전에 열심히 해야 해요.
lines.en: Yes, so I have to study hard before the exam.
lines.roman: Ne, geuraeseo siheom bogi jeone yeolsimhi haeya haeyo.

lines.beaver: 시험 보기 전에 아침은 꼭 먹어요.
lines.beaver_en: Be sure to eat breakfast before the exam.
lines.beaver_roman: Siheom bogi jeone achimeun kkok meogeoyo.
lines.learner: 네, 밥을 먹고 물병도 채워서 갈게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll eat and fill my water bottle before going.
lines.roman: Ne, babeul meokgo mulbyeongdo chaewoseo galgeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 내일 시험 잘 봐요!
lines.beaver_en: Great. Then good luck on the exam tomorrow!
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Geureom naeil siheom jal bwayo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 시험 끝나고 같이 밥 먹어요!
lines.en: Thanks. Let's eat together after the exam!
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Siheom kkeunnago gachi bap meogeoyo!
